signal_actions.name: Start
signal_actions.description: Start the 1.0.107 state-machine pattern engine with empirical MRC-touch learning and structural exits. The predictor learns next-line direction from exact and crossing touches, tags history by 5m MRC slope and price-side context, and tracks fast, normal, and slow touch intervals; it remains neutral until matching evidence is available. Stairs are the only primary entry authority. Direction BOTH remains free to switch sides; LONG and SHORT restrict trading to the requested side. FAST_BREAK_RETURN, pullback, volume, trend, and favorable-extreme signals are support evidence and cannot open a trade by themselves. Cascade supplies movement timing and activity context only; it does not determine direction or create staged orders. Limit entries use one selected entry order. A position uses one primary reduce-only TP and may add one fixed-size far structural TP when MRC/staircase continuation supports it; quantities stay anchored to the calculated position size and small final remainders are handled safely. Runtime action decision_components accepts components=[...], add, or remove with primary-stairs, support-fast-break-return, support-pullback, support-volume, support-extreme, and support-trend. Market entries open immediately. Limit entries use the selected pattern price or two ticks beyond market when already crossed; any unfilled limit entry is cancelled after the next candle, and a new signal is evaluated only after cancellation is confirmed.

params.name: Initial budget %
params.description: Percent of max_amount reserved for the internal trading budget.

params.name: Trading amount %
params.description: Normal entry size as a percent of the deployable budget. Clamped to 10-100.

params.name: Minimum TP %
params.description: Minimum TP distance for every MRC pattern exit. 0 disables this floor.

params.name: Minimum SL %
params.description: Minimum SL distance for every strategy exit. A closer stop is expanded away from entry; 0 disables this minimum.

params.name: Risk target %
params.description: Optional target price-movement risk. When greater than 0, reduce the aggregate entry size when the projected stop-loss distance is wider than this percentage; 0 disables the adjustment.

params.name: Required samples
params.description: Minimum number of observations used by the adaptive pattern engine before normal learned statistics are considered; continuation patterns can still trade when a stair is detected.

params.name: Primary rules
params.description: Choose which primary entry authority is active. Direction LONG plus Stairs is the CAP long-stairs profile.

params.name: Entry order
params.description: Market opens immediately. Limit uses the strategy solution or two ticks beyond market when already crossed, then expires after the next candle if it is not filled. Configured minimum TP and SL distances apply to the exit; a new signal is evaluated after the cancellation is confirmed.
